mission.goal: Detect and block false-reality claims, preserve valid owner capability, prevent duplicate construction, select the smallest governed improvement, and centrally verify and manage Federation and ChatGPT fault books without false host-binding claims.
mission.workflow: Structured claim and evidence enter a deterministic truth gate; a separate capability broker filters and deduplicates a provenance manifest; the pre-build gate blocks duplicate construction; and a host-invoked material-cycle upgrade gate checks environment identity, capability preservation and correction debt before routing to observe, patch, candidate or block.
mission.data: Caller-supplied JSON claims, evidence metadata, scope, objective and capability manifests; optional redacted audit log, atomic learning ledger, or verified private hash-chained fault-book registry.
mission.interface: Python library and command-line scan, resolve, prebuild, upgrade, federation-upgrade, learn, faultbook-import, faultbook-verify, faultbook-manifest, taxonomy and health commands.
mission.environment: Offline local workspace; no provider credentials or network runtime.
mission.governance: Formation mission MISSION-REALITYGUARD-040-GOVERNED-AUTO-UPGRADE; A0-A2; zero cost; host-invoked material cycles; one explicitly selected effectful path only after a separate single-use permit; no self-promotion.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid input, insufficient proof, partial scope, stale evidence, false ownership, unauthorized effects, duplicate capability, capability dilution, unverified inventory, environment inheritance, correction-debt cycles, protected-capability loss, ungoverned self-upgrade and unproven or over-broad gaps.
mission.testing: 115 passing unit, integration, CLI, failure-first, healthy-path, redaction, reuse-ranking, pre-build, automatic-upgrade, correction-debt, universal Federation-adapter, learning-ledger, fault-book integrity, compatibility, privacy, idempotency and semantic regression tests; the adaptive competency separately passes 10/10 tests and validation.
mission.deployment: Not externally deployed or browser-installed. ChatBridge 0.2.0 includes a read-only Windows policy-readiness assessor and enterprise handoff, but the assessor has not run on the target work laptop and external deployment was not authorized.
mission.continuity: Canonical truth, solution, pre-build, upgrade and fault import IDs; idempotent learning and fault fingerprints; deterministic reruns; collision-safe fault-book revisions; dependency-ordered correction debt; project memory, handoff, documentation gate and recovery files.

classification.type: local deterministic truth control and reuse-first solution broker
classification.data_sensitivity: caller-controlled; secrets redacted in optional logs

assumptions.stack: Python 3.11 or newer with standard library.
assumptions.runtime: Single-process CLI or imported library call.
assumptions.storage: No required storage for scan/resolve; optional append-only JSONL audit log, atomically published learning ledger, or atomic private fault-book registry.
assumptions.authentication: Not applicable to offline core; adapters must provide separate authenticated evidence.
assumptions.deployment: Local execution only in this authorized build.

components.frontend: CLI JSON interface; no graphical UI.
components.backend: RealityGuard deterministic truth engine, capability registry/broker, solution router, manifest-bound pre-build gate, governed material-cycle upgrade engine, universal Federation source adapter, learning ledger and central fault-book manager.
components.database: No database; optional JSON registries are local, atomic and caller-selected.
components.queue: Not required; synchronous single request path.
components.worker: Not required; caller process performs analysis.
components.scheduler: Not required; an integrated host invokes the upgrade decision at material BUILD, FAILURE, RECOVERY, DEPLOYMENT or CANARY boundaries. No autonomous or persistent daemon is claimed.
components.cache: Not required; stale proof must not be cached.
components.storage: One selected optional local mutation path per invocation: secret-redacted JSONL audit, atomic idempotent learning ledger, or atomic verified private fault-book registry.
components.authentication: Adapter responsibility; core accepts no credentials.

observability.correlation_ids: Deterministic rg- SHA-256 prefix derived from canonical input.
observability.health_checks: realityguard health emits mode and external-binding truth.
observability.structured_logs: JSON stdout and JSON error objects.
observability.metrics_alerts: Caller may count exit codes, upgrade decisions, recurrence and correction debt; no daemon or alerting service is claimed.

testing.unit: Lifecycle, evidence admissibility, verdict, capability ranking/deduplication, solution action, material-cycle routing, environment attestation, capability preservation, correction-debt ordering, learning promotion, event-chain integrity, fault fingerprints and consumer binding tests.
testing.integration: CLI subprocess, resolve, prebuild, upgrade, learn, fault-book import/verify/manifest, Federation adapter, atomic registry/ledger and redaction tests.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Health plus false-ownership, interface-semantic-gap, ChatBridge duplicate-build, genuine residual-gap and RealityGuard material-cycle patch fixtures.
testing.fixtures_mocks: examples/false_ownership.json, examples/interface_semantic_gap.json, examples/chatbridge_solution_request.json, examples/chatbridge_prebuild_request.json, examples/genuine_gap_prebuild_request.json, examples/material_cycle_upgrade.json, examples/federation_capabilities.json and governed incident records.
testing.failure_first: Stale, failed, self-reported, partial, draft-only, transport-only, self-sealing, stale-live-capability, unauthorized-effect, duplicate-capability, unverified inventory, snapshot mismatch, environment inheritance, capability loss, correction cycle, background-daemon claim, authority/cost/burden expansion, lifecycle-gap replacement, over-broad gap, self-promotion, tampered fault events, parent mismatch, duplicate event IDs, false host binding, private-manifest leakage and premature closure paths.

delivery.file_tree: README, package source, 30-class taxonomy, tests, examples, provenance manifests, executable Federation auto-upgrade adapter, redacted central fault-book manifest and contract, documentation and competency gates, adaptive learning proof, security, recovery, memory and handoff.
run_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli resolve --input examples/chatbridge_solution_request.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli prebuild --input examples/chatbridge_prebuild_request.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli upgrade --input examples/material_cycle_upgrade.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json

PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli federation-upgrade --input examples/material_cycle_upgrade.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json --adapter-contract federation/REALITYGUARD_AUTO_UPGRADE_ADAPTER.v1.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli faultbook-import --ledger FAULTS.jsonl --metadata IMPORT.json --registry PRIVATE_REGISTRY.json
deploy_commands: Not authorized: create a separately permitted browser/API adapter and prove target installation, binding and readback.
rollback_commands: Remove RealityGuard from the caller pre-output/material-cycle hook; restore the prior source revision; preserve the optional evidence ledger; core has no remote runtime state.
delivery.debugging: Use correlation_id, decision_id, learning_fingerprint, inventory_manifest_hash, environment scope, capability losses, correction repair order, structured findings, rejected capability reasons, provenance and optional local logs.

formation.authority_class: A2 local build, private import and test only
formation.effectful_permit: CONSUMED for the bounded local manager build and private registry import in the trusted runtime permit store; secret tokens intentionally excluded. Upgrade and fault-book decisions never act as permits.

watchman.pre_output_rule: Suppress the original status whenever verdict is not ALLOW_BOUNDED.
watchman.promotion_rule: Never promote beyond the maximum admissible current evidence state.
watchman.owner_rule: Only OWNER_ACCEPTED evidence may prove ACCEPTED.

continuity.idempotency: Canonical JSON input produces stable truth, solution, pre-build, upgrade and fault import IDs; learning fingerprints increment recurrence in one record; exact fault-book re-imports perform no write; changed sources retain prior revision identity; semantic duplicates and explicitly superseded capabilities are suppressed.
continuity.resume_conditions: Rerun the 115-test suite and 10-test adaptive competency suite; verify the private fault-book registry and redacted manifest; validate documentation and competency gates; confirm capability freshness, environment attestation and inventory hash; preserve invocation/source-only maturity unless new target runtime readback exists.
continuity.stop_switch: Terminate the process; omit --audit-log for zero writes.

proof.test_results: 115/115 RealityGuard tests passing plus 10/10 adaptive competency tests; current run receipt must accompany source promotion.
proof.semantic_verification: False-ownership and interface-semantic-gap fixtures block false reality. ChatBridge remains protected from duplicate replacement. Material-cycle fixtures preserve capabilities and require a separate Formation permit. Fault-book fixtures reject tampering, parent mismatch, duplicate IDs, false host binding, private-manifest leakage and premature closure. The Federation source adapter and central fault-book manifest record unbound systems as ADAPTER_REQUIRED rather than claiming live binding.
proof.deployment_readback: NOT_APPLICABLE: external deployment not authorized or claimed.
proof.scope: Local offline deterministic truth, reuse-first solution, host-invoked automatic-upgrade and central fault-book management foundation; Federation source-contract registration and redacted manifest, not universal ChatGPT or live runtime binding.
